local calls={}
local actor=setmetatable({},{__index=function(_,name) return function(_,...) calls[#calls+1]={name,...} end end})
local callback=cmd(sleep,0
pulse;effectmagnitude,1,1,1;effectcolor2,.97,1.02,1,1;effectcolor1,1.03,.98,1,1;)
callback(actor)
local expected={'sleep','pulse','effectmagnitude','effectcolor2','effectcolor1'}
for i,name in ipairs(expected) do assert(calls[i][1]==name) end
assert(#calls==5 and calls[1][2]==0 and #calls[2]==1)
print('native cmd accepts adjacent commands without semicolon: sleep,pulse,effectmagnitude,effectcolor2,effectcolor1')
